$about: composite-tab-stop: 12 known violations, open. Recorded rather than silenced.
shape: role=listbox rendered ALWAYS-OPEN on a docs page: container tabindex=-1, every option tabindex=-1, and no element in the served bytes carries aria-controls or aria-activedescendant pointing at it (verified by grep on the built HTML).
mechanism: Same class as the naming and roving-tabstop defects: Base UI wires the combobox relationship (aria-controls, aria-activedescendant, aria-expanded) in layout effects that do not run on the server.
severity_honest: Real, but scoped to the always-open demo shape. In production usage the list lives in a popup that is closed at SSR and renders null, so there is nothing to grade. The docs pages render it open on purpose to show it.
fix: The next adapter increment: a useComboboxWiring beside useFieldWiring and useOpenMirror, minting the listbox id at render and threading aria-controls/aria-activedescendant onto the input. Same pattern, same public-prop route.
why_not_silenced: Weakening the rule to skip listboxes with no controller would make it blind to a standalone listbox that genuinely has no tab stop — which is list-box.tsx, still on React Aria and in this list for a different reason. The rule is right; the code is not finished.
